title: Norepinephrine: research frontiers (R-10008)
description: Norepinephrine is a neurotransmitter of the nervous system. Its role: governs arousal, attention, and the fight-or-flight stress response; also regulates blood pressure. Key fact: active in both the brain and the peripheral sympathetic nervous system. Current research probes Norepinephrine with ever finer tools, from single-cell recording to whole-brain imaging. Closely associated with arousal, attention, and stress response.
